whatIs: Color Hunt is a gallery of hand-picked color palettes. You can sort them by newest or most popular, filter them by time period, color or theme, such as pastel or vintage, and explore collections.
It's a good fit when you need a harmonious color combination to start a design and prefer to begin with something already tested.
uses: Choosing the base colors of a landing page or a portfolio from a popular palette.
Searching for palettes by theme, such as pastel or vintage, to give a project a specific style.
Using the Chrome extension to browse palettes without leaving your workflow.
caveats: These are just color palettes: you have to define each color's role yourself and check contrast for accessibility.
A nice palette doesn't guarantee readable text on backgrounds of those same colors; test it before using it.
Check the site's terms if you plan to use the palettes in a commercial product.
idealFor: People who need quick color inspiration for an interface or a brand.
